symptom: An inline `style:` on a dynamictext was refused by check (MDL-WIDGET03) and by create page, so `describe` -> `exec` of Studio Pro pages that carry one (WorkflowCommons.WorkflowAttachment_View) failed, and building blocks with one were blocked (ako/mxcli#2183).
cause: #673 added the refusal on the claim that such BSON crashed MxBuild with a NullReferenceException; the claim came from the skills, with no recorded reproduction.
insight: A refusal that cites a crash needs the crash reproduced, or at least recorded, before it ships: this one blocked valid Studio Pro output for months. The cheapest disproof was a Studio Pro-authored instance already in testdata/testapp (a styled dynamic text in a Marketplace module), followed by mx check + docker build on 11.12.1. Note too that alter page never enforced the refusal, so the rule was inconsistent from the start.
